# Nivin Xavier

> Serial entrepreneur, digital marketing consultant, and founder based in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. Entrepreneur since 8th grade. 15 years driving measurable growth for startups to Fortune 500 companies worldwide.

Nivin Xavier is a data-driven digital marketing and analytics consultant, startup founder, and builder with over 15 years of experience. He has worked with companies ranging from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 corporations across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, India, and MENA. He is the founder of CGEC Canada, Omni Vue AI, Atlantic Blinds, and LifeSpace Blinds, and has previously held senior roles at Ayruz Data Marketing, Muthoot Group, and data POWA.

## Current Ventures

- CGEC Canada (Founder): Canada's not-for-profit council helping Canadian businesses launch and expand into the United Kingdom, European Economic Area, and India, backed by 13 years of EICBI's institutional relationships across parliamentary corridors.
- Omni Vue AI (Founder): AI-powered omni-channel brand intelligence platform for tracking, analysing, benchmarking, and amplifying brand exposure across social media, connected TV, OTT, and news.
- Atlantic Blinds (Founder): Premium window coverings brand serving residential and commercial clients in Atlantic Canada.
- LifeSpace Blinds (Founder, Exited): Window blinds manufacturing brand, built and exited over a 23-year journey.
